name: Cold Winter Deserts of Turan
description: This vast natural site stitches together fourteen separate protected areas across Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan and Turkmenistan, stretching over 1,500 kilometres between the Caspian Sea and the Turanian high mountains. Its sandy, clay and stony deserts endure freezing winters and scorching summers, yet support a remarkably rich variety of plants and animals adapted to the harshness.
